subject: Order form commercial alignment: invoice cadence, gross-up, entity split
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@neptunehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@neptunehealth.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@neptunehealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order form - commercial clarifications before legal sign-off

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for sending the latest Order Form (attached). Procurement has a few items we need clarified before we run this across our SOW and PO process: 

1) Invoice cadence / entity split — Neptune purchases via two legal entities (Neptune Health, Inc. and Neptune Clinical Services LLC). We need invoices split by entity and to confirm whether Redwood can issue two separate invoices per quarter or whether you require a consolidated invoice with internal re-allocation on our side.

2) Net terms — Procurement prefers Net30 from date of invoice. Please confirm Redwood can support Net30 and whether early-payment discounts are available.

3) Taxes / withholding — As a US customer, we may be required to withhold certain payments to the US parent if services cross state lines. Will Redwood accept invoices net of withholding or do you require a gross-up clause? Also ask: can you provide Redwood’s VAT/GST registration (if applicable) or tax residency certificate?

4) PO reference — We will only remit payment if the invoice includes our PO#. We need to confirm Redwood can include PO# and invoice-specific remit instructions.

Please see attached Neptune_OrderForm_v4.pdf (redline request) and let us know what you need from legal on our side. Happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,
Sara Liu
Head of Procurement
Neptune Health

Attachment: Neptune_OrderForm_v4.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@neptunehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form - commercial clarifications before legal sign-off

Hi Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline below, and I’ve attached a short redline summary for your procurement/legal team.

1) Invoice cadence / entity split: We can support issuing two invoices per quarter, one to each Neptune entity, provided you confirm which entity is responsible for which portion of the minimum commit. Operationally we prefer separate invoices per legal entity (so accounting has clean GL mapping).

2) Net terms: We can accept Net30 from invoice date. Our standard flows Net30 without an automatic early-pay discount, but we can discuss a 1%/15-day discount for higher-volume, annual prepay arrangements (would need approvals).

3) Taxes / withholding: Redwood’s preferred position is that the customer is responsible for taxes, VAT/GST, and any withholding obligations. We can accept invoices net of withholding only if customer provides (i) a valid tax certificate/evidence supporting the withholding within 30 days of payment and (ii) pays any compensating tax documentation fees. Alternatively, we can add a gross-up clause to the Order Form that requires Neptune to pay additional amounts so that Redwood receives the full net amount invoiced. That gross-up requires CFO-level sign-off; we’re open to it but would need explicit wording in the contract.

4) PO reference: We will include your PO# on the invoice and require it for processing. Please confirm the PO format and whether you will provide a separate purchase order per invoice (preferred) or a standing PO for the year.

Next steps I propose: Ben and I will loop in Legal (Kim) for a quick pass on 1–3 and then share RF_OrderForm_v4_redline.docx back to you by EOD. If that works, we can push a DocuSign envelope once legal approves the language.

I’ve attached a one-page redline summary (orderform-redline-summary.xlsx) that maps each commercial ask to the proposed contract language.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachment: orderform-redline-summary.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@neptunehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-21T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form - commercial clarifications before legal sign-off

Sara / Marissa —

Thanks — quick commercial notes from our side to keep the momentum: 

• Minimum commit phasing: Neptune indicated a staggered ramp. We propose the minimum commit be allocated by quarter (Q1 25%, Q2 25%, Q3 25%, Q4 25%) with true-up at year-end. Unused committed tokens convert to credits redeemable within 12 months.
• Invoicing and PO: We can accept PO# on every invoice. If Neptune prefers a standing PO, please confirm PO number and exact remit-to entity.
• DocuSign: Once legal aligns, I’ll drop a DocuSign link. We can accept PO issuance post-signature; many enterprise customers do that.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute call today if helpful to finalize cadence and commit split before legal finalizes wording.

Best,
Ben Carter
Principal Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@neptunehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-22T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order form - commercial clarifications before legal sign-off

Sara / team —

Thanks for the context. Legal has reviewed the attached summary and proposed redlines; key positions below (we included inline redline document RF_OrderForm_v4_redline.docx for your counsel):

1) Net terms: Net30 is acceptable. We will keep Net30 in the Order Form. Late payments will accrue interest per the rate in the MSA (1.5% per month) unless parties agree otherwise in writing.

2) Entity mapping & invoicing: Redwood requires (i) that each invoice clearly state the purchasing entity and PO number; (ii) invoices be issued to the legal entity identified in the Order Form; and (iii) that bank remittance information references Redwood Inference, Inc. (domestic bank details provided in the attached redline). If Neptune needs invoices issued to multiple entities, we will issue separate invoices and coordinate invoice counts with procurement.

3) Taxes & withholding: Our preferred clause remains that Customer is responsible for all taxes and withholding. Two options acceptable to Redwood: 
   a) Customer pays amounts net of any withholding and provides supporting tax documentation within 30 days, and Customer is responsible for any gross-up shortfall if supporting documentation is not provided; OR
   b) Customer accepts a gross-up obligation (i.e., pay additional amounts so Redwood receives invoiced amount) — if Neptune requires gross-up, we will add a clause and require a separate signature from Neptune’s CFO.

4) Proof and evidence: If Neptune withholds tax, Customer must provide to Redwood within 30 days of remittance the withholding certificate or official tax receipt demonstrating the deduction. Failure to supply this documentation will give Redwood the right to invoice the shortfall and charge interest as above.

5) Timeline & acceptance: Please have Neptune counsel review RF_OrderForm_v4_redline.docx. If the redlines are acceptable, confirm by 2026-10-25 so we can issue DocuSign the same week. If Neptune proposes the gross-up path, please copy your CFO on the response.

For remediation: I attached the redline doc and the spreadsheet mapping. If helpful, I’m available for a 30-minute call Thurs (10/22) 11:00–11:30am PT.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: RF_OrderForm_v4_redline.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
